Goal: a working both request in ≤ 10 minutes. Keys below are for tests only.

  1. Create test keysHMAC ≥ 32 chars; AEAD exactly 32 bytes (base64).
  2. Sender sidebuildHeadersAndBody.
  3. Receiver sideverify with the server's method/path/query.
  4. Send the requestX-* headers + body.
  5. Tamper testChange the body → must fail.

Client example

php
<?php
use SecurePayload\SecurePayload;

// TEST keys only — never use in production
$hmac = str_repeat('a', 32);
$aead = base64_encode(random_bytes(32));

$sp = new SecurePayload([
  'mode' => 'both',
  'clientId' => 'demo',
  'keyId' => 'v1',
  'hmacSecretRaw' => $hmac,
  'aeadKeyB64' => $aead,
]);

[$headers, $body] = $sp->buildHeadersAndBody(
  'https://example.test/api/orders', 'POST',
  ['orderId' => 1]
);

Server example

php
<?php
$sp = new SecurePayload([
  'mode' => 'both',
  'keyLoader' => function ($cid, $kid) use ($hmac, $aead) {
    return ['hmacSecret' => $hmac, 'aeadKeyB64' => $aead];
  },
  // multi-server: inject replayStore + requireReplayStore
]);

$result = $sp->verify($headers, $body, 'POST', '/api/orders', '');
// $result['ok'] === true on success
‼
Don't

Do not take method/path/query from X-Canonical-Request.

!
Multi-server

The default file cache is not shared. Use replayStore + requireReplayStore.
